problem.statement_latex: For $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\{0,1\}$, distinguish functions with no $x,y$ satisfying $f(x)=f(y)=f(x+y)=1$ from functions $\varepsilon$-far from that property. Access consists of uniform quantum examples.
